datasetDef: X: 19 disorder evidence-corpus embeddings (disorder_evidence_pca_v1, corpus ac4d97d111e2); Y: 19 NeuroQuery meta-map region profiles (83 regions, column-z-scored, PCA to 8). Both views derive from the research literature — alignment measures curation/automated-mining consistency, NOT independent biological validation.
preprocessing: X used as built (log1p counts -> z-score -> PCA-8). Y: per-region z-score across disorders -> PCA-8 (seed 42).
model: CCA, 3 components (scikit-learn); significance by 1000 row-permutations of Y (refit per permutation, per-component p = (1+#perm>=observed)/(1+N)).
